name: Triborg
description: (Tag:ice)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:tech)(Tag:teleporter)(Tech)Triborg is a highly advanced cyborg fused with the skills and data of multiple master martial artists, assassins, and predecessors. Its robotic physique grants superhuman stats and reconfigurable forms like Smoke for close-range teleportation and Sub-Zero for cryo weaponry with only one form usable at a time, and it may be upgraded with Tinker abilities.
